== Ingredients ==
* 2–4 [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausages]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 2–3 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinches]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Chopping|Chopped]] vegetables (optional)

== Procedure ==

# Add the sausages to a hot [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]]. [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]], turning, until sausage is cooked through.
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the eggs with the salt.
# Transfer egg mixture to pan along with vegetables, if using. Fry for 30–60 seconds.
# Serve.
